name: spec-list
title: Spec list
summary: Facts people check, as on a product sheet: a mono label beside its value, one per row, between hairlines.
use: For details, not settings: a file's format and duration, a project's size, an export's settings.
rules: One fact per row; never a paragraph of figures.
Values people change belong in property rows, not a spec list.
accessibility: Each row reads as its label and value.
